note: Decree 25-320 (2025-12-30) sets up a data governance scheme with a data classification referentiel and a data source cataloguing referentiel (to be drawn up and published by the High Commission, not yet published) and an exchange system; no technical exchange standards (formats, codes, interfaces, protocols) are stated, and the two referentiels cover classification and cataloguing, so no fact.
